name: Next Beverly Hills Committee Regular Meeting Agenda (PDF)
agenda_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I Next Beverly Hills Committee
  will conduct a Regular Meeting, at the following time and place, and will address the
  agenda listed below:

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  Municipal Gallery
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  IN-PERSON I TELEPHONIC I VIDEO CONFERENCE MEETING

  Beverly Hills Liaison Committee Meeting
  https:Ilbeverlyhills-orq.zoom.us/mylnextbh
  Meeting ID: 511 714 8143
  Passcode: 90210

  You can also dial in by phone:
  +1 346 248 7799 US
  +1 833 548 0282 US Toll-free

  One tap mobile
  +13462487799,,5117148143#,,,,*90210# US
  +1 8335480282,,51 171481 43#,,,,*9021 0# US Toll-free

  Thursday, April 20, 2023
  6:30 PM

Please be advised that pre-en try metal detector screening requirements are now in place
in City Hall. Members of the public are requested to plan visits accordingly.

In the interest of maintaining appropriate social distancing, members of the public can view this
meeting through live webcast at www.beverlyhills.orci/live and on BH Channel 10 or Channel
35 on Spectrum Cable, and can participate in the teleconference/video conference by using the
link above. Written comments may be emailed to mayorandcitycouncil(äbeverlyhills.org and
will also be taken during the meeting when the topic is being reviewed by the Beverly Hills City
Council Liaison / Next Beverly Hills Committee. Beverly Hills Liaison meetings will be in-person
at City Hall.

  AGENDA

1) Public Comment

  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the Committee
  on any item not listed on the agenda.

2) Welcome & Introductions

  a. Next Beverly Hills Chair Noah Etessami and Vice Chair Charles Smith
  b. Mayor Julian A. Gold, M.D. and Vice Mayor Lester Friedman
  c. Introduction of New Attendees
   d. Special Speakers
  i. Abby Arnold and Jenny Swan, Beverly Hills Unhoused Assistance
  Plan

4) New Business

  a. Upcoming Events
  i. Next Night (Tentatively scheduled for Saturday, September 9, 2023 pending
  City Council approval)
  ii. Art Show (Saturday, May 20, 2023 and Sunday, May 21, 2023 at Beverly
  Gardens Park)
  iii. Earth Day (Sunday, April 23, 2023 at the Farmer’s Market)
  iv. Prospective Events: Ice Skating Rink, Haunted Greystone, etc.
  b. Subcommittee Action Items
  i. Art Subcommittee
  ii. Culture Subcommittee
  iii. Charity Subcommittee
  iv. Sustainability Subcommittee
  c. City Council Liaisons Civic Awareness Updates
  —

  d. Next Up City Announcements for the Next Generation
  —

5) Current Business

  a. Open Discussion (Share interesting next gen-related information, events, invites, and
  ideas)

6)  Future Agenda Items Discussion

7) Adjournment
  a. The upcoming Next Beverly Hills Committee meeting is scheduled for May 25, 2023
  at 6:30 p.m.

Huma Ahmed
City Clerk

Posted: April 13, 2023
